T_k: The correction goes back to the better-scoring iter-4 balance: a centred, even x4 term damped by |x5|, plus a steep saturating x2*x5 interaction that raises predictions when x2 and x5 share a sign and lowers them when the signs differ. A small one-sided term adds extra lift only when x2 and x5 are both positive, the quadrant where the hardest underpredictions remain.
